instruction: A warehouse starts with 1752 boxes. It first increases its stock by 18 percent, discarding any fractional box (rounded down). Then it ships 40 percent of the new stock, again discarding any fractional box (rounded down). How many boxes does it have at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
